description: This file defines external API function declarations and constants related to WTC RBUS interactions and statistics parameter management within a C project.

methods.name: WTC_RbusInit
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS interface for WTC communication.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Retrieves parameter name from a given path.

methods.name: CheckIfValidDscp
methods.description: Checks the validity of the DSCP string.

methods.name: IsDigit
methods.description: Checks if the given string is a digit.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets the ULONG value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the string value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets the ULONG value of a specified parameter.
